text: Both are faults of a general mechanism, and both landed in template v35 (368a422), recorded as dft-23-landed and dft-24-landed (fdb4c9a). run_example itself was the adapter of build qe-pw-examples/0001, made in a test clone and not in this repository, so it is not versioned here. dft-23: the QE adapter here (req-qe-h2-bond-001, builds qe-h2-bond/0001 on, 2026-11-20) already took n_processes through mpirun, but nothing general carried it. v35's src/engine_wait.py starts an engine on a call's count through the launcher the adapter names, directly with none, and processes_error() returns invalid_input for a count that is not a positive integer and unavailable where the launcher is not there. On 'within what the gate allows': the gate reads only the permission's level, which names no count, so it allows any; a ceiling would be a value the person sets, and none is inferred. dft-24: v34's engine_wait opened its logs with 'wb' and wrote over them; the QE and HOOMD adapters each made stamped folders by hand. In v35, new_run_folder(kind) makes runs/<kind>/<UTC stamp>/ and never takes a folder that exists; run() never opens a log that exists; and the builder refuses an adapter that starts an engine through engine_wait and makes no new run folder (bundle.run_folder_problems). Both repository adapters pass it as they are. Shown in meta_agent/tests/test_template_v35.py on two unrelated fake engines, neither rheology (a self-consistent field solver and a heat-diffusion solver), watched failing with v34's tree in v35's place. No build is on v35 yet, and no bundle of it has been tested standing alone. The timeout (dft-17) is left to the session answering ask -2-1.
